SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, b.score / MAX(b.score) OVER () AS score
FROM (
    SELECT w.nid, CAST(ln(1 + (w.n - w.df1 + 0.5) / (w.df1 + 0.5)) * w.tf1 * 2.2 / (w.tf1 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0)))
        + ln(1 + (w.n - w.df2 + 0.5) / (w.df2 + 0.5)) * w.tf2 * 2.2 / (w.tf2 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0))) AS double precision) AS score
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*, (
            SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS double precision)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'text') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'text')), '')) AS len
                FROM g_node c
                WHERE c.labels @> '["Chunk"]'
            ) l) AS n, (
            SELECT CAST(AVG(l.len) AS double precision)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'text') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'text')), '')) AS len
                FROM g_node c
                WHERE c.labels @> '["Chunk"]'
            ) l) AS avglen, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df1, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf2 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df2
        FROM (
            SELECT s.nid, s.len, (SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft1 AS text), 'g')) AS tf1, (SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft2 AS text), 'g')) AS tf2
            FROM (
                SELECT c.nid, lower(COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'text') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'text')), '')) AS text, length(COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'text') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'text')), '')) AS len
                FROM g_node c
                WHERE c.labels @> '["Chunk"]'
            ) s
            WHERE (s.text ~ CAST($_cy_ft3 AS text) OR s.text ~ CAST($_cy_ft4 AS text))
        ) h
    ) w
) b
JOIN g_node c ON c.nid = b.nid
WHERE b.score > 0

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, JSON_TRANSFORM(c.props, SET '$.labels' = c.labels, SET '$."__drivine.stamp"' = c.stamp) AS doc, b.score / MAX(b.score) OVER () AS score
FROM (
    SELECT w.nid, LN(1 + (w.n - w.df1 + 0.5) / (w.df1 + 0.5)) * w.tf1 * 2.2 / (w.tf1 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0)))
        + LN(1 + (w.n - w.df2 + 0.5) / (w.df2 + 0.5)) * w.tf2 * 2.2 / (w.tf2 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0))) AS score
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*, (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM (
                SELECT NVL(LENGTH(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(c.props, '$.text.v' RETURNING CLOB), JSON_VALUE(c.props, '$.text' RETURNING CLOB))), 0) AS len
                FROM GRAPH_TABLE (g
                    MATCH (c IS node WHERE JSON_EXISTS(c.labels, '$[*]?(@ == "Chunk")'))
                    COLUMNS (c.props)) c
            ) l) AS n, (
            SELECT AVG(l.len)
            FROM (
                SELECT NVL(LENGTH(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(c.props, '$.text.v' RETURNING CLOB), JSON_VALUE(c.props, '$.text' RETURNING CLOB))), 0) AS len
                FROM GRAPH_TABLE (g
                    MATCH (c IS node WHERE JSON_EXISTS(c.labels, '$[*]?(@ == "Chunk")'))
                    COLUMNS (c.props)) c
            ) l) AS avglen, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df1, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf2 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df2
        FROM (
            SELECT s.nid, s.len, REGEXP_COUNT(s.text, $_cy_ft1) - REGEXP_COUNT(s.text, $_cy_ft2) AS tf1, REGEXP_COUNT(s.text, $_cy_ft3) - REGEXP_COUNT(s.text, $_cy_ft4) AS tf2
            FROM (
                SELECT c.nid, LOWER(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(c.props, '$.text.v' RETURNING CLOB), JSON_VALUE(c.props, '$.text' RETURNING CLOB))) AS text, NVL(LENGTH(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(c.props, '$.text.v' RETURNING CLOB), JSON_VALUE(c.props, '$.text' RETURNING CLOB))), 0) AS len
                FROM GRAPH_TABLE (g
                    MATCH (c IS node WHERE JSON_EXISTS(c.labels, '$[*]?(@ == "Chunk")'))
                    COLUMNS (c.nid, c.props)) c
            ) s
            WHERE (REGEXP_LIKE(s.text, $_cy_ft5) OR REGEXP_LIKE(s.text, $_cy_ft6))
        ) h
    ) w
) b
JOIN g_node c ON c.nid = b.nid
WHERE b.score > 0

SELECT h.nid, h.labels, h.props, h.stamp, h.doc, h.score / MAX(h.score) OVER () AS score
FROM (
    SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, JSON_TRANSFORM(c.props, SET '$.labels' = c.labels, SET '$."__drivine.stamp"' = c.stamp) AS doc, k.score
    FROM (SELECT s.nid, SCORE(1) AS score FROM g_t_Chunktext_16a97b00 s WHERE JSON_TEXTCONTAINS(s.doc, '$.text', $_cy_ft1, 1)) k
    JOIN g_node c ON c.nid = k.nid
    WHERE INSTR(',' || LTRIM(RTRIM(JSON_SERIALIZE(c.labels), ']'), '[') || ',"', ',"Chunk","') > 0
) h
WHERE h.score > 0

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, b.score / MAX(b.score) OVER () AS score
FROM (
    SELECT w.nid, CAST(drivine_math('log', 1 + (w.n - w.df1 + 0.5) / (w.df1 + 0.5)) * w.tf1 * 2.2 / (w.tf1 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0)))
        + drivine_math('log', 1 + (w.n - w.df2 + 0.5) / (w.df2 + 0.5)) * w.tf2 * 2.2 / (w.tf2 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0))) AS REAL) AS score
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*, (
            SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."text".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."text"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."text"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."text"' END)), '')) AS len
                FROM g_node c
                WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Chunk"') > 0
            ) l) AS n, (
            SELECT CAST(AVG(l.len) AS REAL)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."text".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."text"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."text"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."text"' END)), '')) AS len
                FROM g_node c
                WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Chunk"') > 0
            ) l) AS avglen, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df1, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf2 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df2
        FROM (
            SELECT s.nid, s.len, drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft1 AS TEXT)) AS tf1, drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft2 AS TEXT)) AS tf2
            FROM (
                SELECT c.nid, drivine_lower(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."text".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."text"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."text"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."text"' END)), '')) AS text, length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."text".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."text"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."text"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."text"' END)), '')) AS len
                FROM g_node c
                WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Chunk"') > 0
            ) s
            WHERE (drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft3 AS TEXT)) > 0 OR drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft4 AS TEXT)) > 0)
        ) h

        + drivine_math('log', 1 + (w.n - w.df2 + 0.5) / (w.df2 + 0.5)) * w.tf2 * 2.2 / (w.tf2 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0)))
        + drivine_math('log', 1 + (w.n - w.df3 + 0.5) / (w.df3 + 0.5)) * w.tf3 * 2.2 / (w.tf3 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0))) AS REAL) AS score

                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."text".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."text"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."text"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."text"' END)), '')) AS len

    FROM (SELECT s.nid, SCORE(1) AS score FROM g_t_Chunktext_16a97b00 s WHERE JSON_TEXTCONTAINS(s.doc, '$.text', $_cy_ft1, 1)) k
    JOIN g_node c ON c.nid = k.nid

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, b.score / MAX(b.score) OVER () AS score
FROM (
    SELECT w.nid, CAST(drivine_math('log', 1 + (w.n - w.df1 + 0.5) / (w.df1 + 0.5)) * w.tf1 * 2.2 / (w.tf1 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0))) AS REAL) AS score
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*, (
            SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."text".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."text"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."text"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."text"' END)), '')) AS len
                FROM g_node c
                WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Chunk"') > 0
            ) l) AS n, (
            SELECT CAST(AVG(l.len) AS REAL)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."text".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."text"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."text"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."text"' END)), '')) AS len
                FROM g_node c
                WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Chunk"') > 0
            ) l) AS avglen, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df1
        FROM (
            SELECT s.nid, s.len, drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft1 AS TEXT)) AS tf1

    SELECT w.nid, CAST(drivine_math('log', 1 + (w.n - w.df1 + 0.5) / (w.df1 + 0.5)) * w.tf1 * 2.2 / (w.tf1 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0)))
        + drivine_math('log', 1 + (w.n - w.df2 + 0.5) / (w.df2 + 0.5)) * w.tf2 * 2.2 / (w.tf2 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0))) AS REAL) AS score
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*, (
            SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."text".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."text"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."text"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."text"' END)), '')) AS len
                FROM g_node c
                WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Chunk"') > 0
            ) l) AS n, (
            SELECT CAST(AVG(l.len) AS REAL)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."text".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."text"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."text"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."text"' END)), '')) AS len
                FROM g_node c
                WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Chunk"') > 0
            ) l) AS avglen, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df1, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf2 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df2
        FROM (
            SELECT s.nid, s.len, drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft1 AS TEXT)) AS tf1, drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft2 AS TEXT)) AS tf2

                FROM g_node c
